Extremely disappointed!!
Jun 2019 • Family
It took them almost 20 minutes to bring a bottle of water, a glass of wine and a cocktail. They brought food even before they serve drink!! The server claimed that the bartender was taking a day off before she apologized. Worst was the bath room. The water from the toilet bowl was overflowing onto the floor, and off course the floor was wet with dirty water.....in a what they claim as a fine dining restaurant. Food was not as exciting as expected. We had better Bun-cha at a different cafe place in the old quarter. They ruined our last night in Hanoi, which was supposed to be a good closing dinner/night of the trip.

Disappointed - Epic Fail
Apr 2019 • Couples
Nice ambiance but food was sub standard. We paid over $125 for a meal that we didn’t eat. The duck was dry and tough and the seafood fried rice (recommended by server) was worse than the option at our hotel’s free breakfast buffet. Waitress didn’t ask if anything was wrong with the meal when she finally came by to clear our dishes. Service quite inattentive, especially considering there was only one other couple dining. Do not waste your money as you’re likely to be disappointed.

A Nice First Night Vietnamese Dinner
Mar 2019 • Friends
Six of us staying at the Hanoi-Sofitel Legend Metropole wanted a Vietnamese restaurant close by for our first night in Hanoi. Club Opera Novel was on the hotel recommended list so we 
all tried it. There is a nice ambience in the restaurant and a couple of the wait staff spoke English. 
The Fried Spring rolls were a great surprise and were served pegged by toothpick to a hollowed out pineapple illuminated by a candle beneath. The rolls were outstanding and crunchy. I highly recommend this appetizer!
I had the fried sea bass which turned out to be fish medallions fried with a nice sauce. It was just okay. My other friend chose the steamed Grouper in tea leaves which she enjoyed. As a side we ordered the eggplant which I thought had too much sauce. Nevertheless the eggplant tasted good. 
In summary, this is s good restaurant with a good variety. The only issue I had was that four of us received their dinner but mine took another 15 min. Prices are 4 star but the quality is good.

A Meal to Sing about
Jul 2018 • Family
A hot evening and a cool restaurant - and we were moving.

We asked if we could BYO - and they obliged, we had some good stuff from home. Corkage is right up there 30,000VD. More than most places at home, but so too are the wine prices in Vietnam.

We started the meal wit the spring rolls - and they were the best tasting so far, and the presentation will be very hard to beat.

We shared the mains which included ground beef in a local leaf, with a dipping sauce. Perfect.

The main dish of prawns was again outstanding with the carrot carved Pagoda sitting astride large succulent fleshy prawns beheaded and gutted - ready to eat.

A roast chicken dish with sticky rice, was completely eclipsed by the seasonal vegies we demolished.

Absolutely a first class meal.
